title: Mik-Nana Food Scale, 10kg/22lb Digital Kitchen Scale Weight Grams and Ounces for Baking Cooking Coffee Package Postage, 6 Units with Tare Function, LCD Display, Easy Clean Stainless Steel
description:
About this item
【Precise Weight】 10kg/22lb capacity, 1g/0.1oz resolution, Great for cooking, baking, weight loss, Meal Prep, Coffee, Package, Postage.
【Multifunction Scale】This digital kitchen scale has 6 measurement unit: g, kg, lb, oz, ml, milk ml.
【Easy Tare】Remove the weight of any container to get more precise results.
【Portable Design】- Small Scale Dimensions:7.4 x 5.5 x 0.6 inches. The digital kitchen scale’s convenient size makes it easy to store in your kitchen.
【LCD Display】Big bright LCD display easy to read. The cute gram scale to turn off after 3 minutes inactivity.
【Easy to Clean】- Digital gram scale is designed with food-grade 304 stainless-steel platform for easy cleaning and maintenance.

reviews_1s:
Useless upon arrival. Weighing is wildly inaccurate and inconsistent. Zeroed it out several times, popped out batteries for a few minutes, etc. Either it was calibrated wrong or is just not a good scale.
Was hoping to use this for weighing some young kittens, but it registers them at nearly 1/5-1/6th of what they should be based on age/size. Double checked on some non-squirmy non-living things, such as coins and fruit, and it rarely got close to accurate reading.
Cheaper unfortunately often equals worse quality. Lesson learned.Upon opening it, I thought it might be worth it. Doing a side by side comparison with the one I own, the weight was off on this one so it wasn’t calibrated correctly. I measure everything for my bread baking. I need accuracy and it just wasn’t there with this!
I kept it thinking I’d give it as a gift, but after doing the comparison on weight and just threw it away because it wasn’t worth the effort to return it.The scale itself is unbalanced. The measurements are way off. I have it as a gift and missed the return window and they won’t let me return or refundClick to play video
Zero stars. It is completely untrustworthy at determining the weight of an object. I placed the same object on it over and over and got different weights each time. See the video for proof.The measurements are inconsistent, sometimes changing even when the item hasn’t moved. It’s really frustrating when you’re trying to be precise with baking or portion control. The tare function is unreliabletoo. Occasionally it resets itself or jumps numbers.I did not like this scale. I liked the way it looked and how bright the read out was, but it did not weigh properly and this is why I returned it.I’ve been using this scale for a couple months to make sourdough bread. Every loaf has come out wrong. I thought I was doing something wrong.

Someone told me tonight a nickel. It should weigh 5 grams. It weighs 4 on my scale.

Don’t waste your money and find a different scale.Scale is not level and therefore inaccurate by touching the area of the scale that should produce no reading it causes a drastic change in the readingI bought this for use in my business. Measuring by weight is much more accurate than measuring by volume. I measure the same ingredients every day and have used a different scale for the past two years until it failed, necessitating the purchaseof this replacement. I know how much one dry ounce of ingredient (by volume) should weigh. This unit not only weighed that dry ounce only half as much as it should, but the unit gave a different answer every single time I re-weighed that ounce. I tared (zeroed out) the unit before my experiment, several times during the experiment, plus I switched between different measuring units. This is simply a useless scale.The scale cannot seem to stay on a number when I am weighing ingredients for baking. It stops and the goes to a different weight ,stops and does this continually. Do not believe it is accurate.
